proposed_from.topic: Sharp rough-Holder generated-donor-proxy minimax frontier for realized-path causal buy-and-hold level wealth. Fix H, proxy dimension p, and finitely many cohorts, and restrict the constructive theory to 0<lambda<=1. Observe N donor scores, exact historical proxy paths at T pre-event sites, n_s replicated bounded untreated histories, and replicated treated event outcomes. At each fixed admissible query z_0, assume query-conditional design densities bounded above and below, geometrically beta-mixing design sequences, conditional independence of complete unit histories across replicas given the exact design, a cohort-common treated conditional mean invariant to the design, rough-Holder historical regressions, event-date transport, interior overlap, limited anticipation, no spillovers, and a uniformly elliptic full covariance for the stacked donor-error path. Determine sharp fixed-query-kernel conditional MSE and uniformly honest expected-length rates, and transfer the constructive upper conclusions to joint panel laws only for marginal-almost-every query through the labelled regular conditional tuple. The target rate has three nonredundant channels: treated replication sum_s pi_s^2/n_s, calendar-design spacing {log(T vee 2)/T}^{2lambda/d}, and generated-query uncertainty N^{-lambda}; on the independent-calendar subclass the spacing term is T^{-2lambda/d}. In the deterministic fixed-design experiment, use a nearest-site estimator with (X,z_0,Sigma) treated as known specifications; in the generated-query experiment, use one feasible observable anchor estimator and total interval chosen before the unknown donor mean, with whole-unit bounded-range concentration and matching treated, spacing, and full-covariance donor lower bounds under the stated strict-slack conditions. TARGET ADJUSTMENT FROM THE ORIGINAL PROPOSAL: local-polynomial/tensor-sieve theory for lambda>1 and calendar-block score inference are outside the proved scope; the replicated-response smoothing expression remains valid bookkeeping but is algebraically dominated by treated replication and spacing for fixed cohorts, so it is not a fourth phase; geometric design mixing incurs the displayed logarithmic spacing penalty, while the iid-design subclass has the no-log rate. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE RETAINED: in the scalar H=0 one-cohort donor subexperiment, donor means separated by order N^{-1/2} can have bounded testing distance, while admissible rough-Holder regressions separate targets by order N^{-lambda/2}, giving the N^{-lambda} MSE and N^{-lambda/2} honest-length lower channels without deconvolution. The scalar iid bookkeeping rate n^{-1} vee (Tn)^{-2lambda/(2lambda+1)} vee T^{-2lambda} vee N^{-lambda} reduces because its smoothing term is dominated. RESOLVED BOTTLENECK: exact historical training coordinates mean no deconvolution phase, whole-unit concentration removes the need for response-calendar mixing or block studentization, and explicit channelwise witnesses match the three-channel frontier. REMAINING LIMITATION: higher-order smoothness and exact phase-intersection constants require separate new arguments.

seed_details.anchor_read: Introduction; Section 4.2, Theorem 1 and its two smoothed first-stage adjustment terms; Appendix proof decomposition; Section 6 conclusion.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace a generated coordinate on every training row by an independent generated evaluation center, then prove uniform Gram coercivity on its Mahalanobis neighborhood before applying the Holder modulus.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for replicated-site regression at an external generated center found Akhavan--Gogolashvili--Tsybakov (2024), but no four-channel causal minimax and honest-length theorem.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Akhavan--Gogolashvili--Tsybakov Theorem 8, Stone, and a triangle inequality.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their center is a minimizer of the same smooth strongly convex regression, so its effect is second order and dominated; they do not have external donor scaling, Holder cusps, replication saturation, realized holes, calendar dependence, or honest-length converses.

seed_details.anchor_read: Introduction; Sections 2--3; Theorems 3.1--3.6; the repeated-difference characteristic-function construction; density and regression proof discussion.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Express the three data architectures as distinct likelihood factorizations and determine exactly when a convolution operator enters the training experiment.
seed_details.destination_search: Generated-regressor, errors-in-variables, and random-center searches found each architecture separately but no necessary-and-sufficient experiment-comparison theorem joining them.
seed_details.red_team: This is only a taxonomy pasting three known literatures.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds unless upgraded to a deficiency or iff theorem, so the factorization is retained only as a supporting lemma rather than the headline.

seed_details.anchor_read: Introduction; Theorem 1; dependent-data Theorem A and its Berbee-coupling and large-block--small-block proof; conclusion.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Derive a stable joint limit for calendar-block local-polynomial scores, realized Gram geometry, and the covariance-standardized generated center before applying any pivotal calibration.
seed_details.destination_search: Mixing local-polynomial limit theory and synthetic-control prediction intervals do not characterize necessity of Gaussian centering at proxy and spacing phase boundaries.
seed_details.red_team: The cusp term is only a generalized delta method added to an existing mixing central limit theorem.
seed_details.rebuttal: A universal cusp limit is unavailable over the full Holder ball; the credible object is a least-favorable limit experiment or pivotality frontier, so this seed is deferred behind the rate theorem.

seed_details.anchor_read: Introduction; Theorem 2 and Corollary 1; hardest-chord reduction; supporting-hyperplane construction; terminal proofs.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Derive a joint local asymptotic experiment for the regular \(\kappa=1\) donor and calendar channels with the full covariance contraction.
seed_details.destination_search: Hahn--Ridder covers differentiable generated regressors, and point evaluation is not pathwise differentiable over the full finite-Holder class.
seed_details.red_team: The regular-phase efficiency bound is an immediate delta-method variance formula.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds for the stated broad class; a separate efficiency paper would require a narrower regular tangent model and materially new shared-cell covariance structure.

seed_details.anchor_read: Introduction; exact and approximate permutation validity theorems; block-permutation construction; concluding discussion.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Build a symmetry orbit jointly for donor centers and overlapping calendar blocks, then invert pathwise counterfactual nulls.
seed_details.destination_search: Conformal synthetic-control inference and dependent block permutations are already occupied, while conditional-on-realized-path mean coverage lacks the required exact symmetry.
seed_details.red_team: The method is already Chernozhukov--Wuthrich--Zhu with a different conformity score.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds, and imposing stronger symmetry would change the intended model merely to fit the motif.

seed_details.anchor_read: Introduction; Proposition 3.1 and its uniform-objective proof; OLS comparison; conclusion.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Treat donor allocation across cohorts as a decision minimizing downstream wealth-estimation risk under a donor budget.
seed_details.destination_search: Synthetic-control donor weighting is an inferential nuisance choice, not a causal treatment policy with a defined welfare value in this topic.
seed_details.red_team: Donor allocation is experimental design or nuisance tuning, not policy learning.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds because no intervention policy or welfare regret is induced by choosing donor scores.

seed_details.anchor_read: Introduction and discussion; main optimal-rate theorem; local-polynomial construction discussion; lower-bound reduction.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace one response per random design point by \(n_s\) responses at each of only \(T\) sites and separate stochastic smoothing from the noiseless spatial-resolution floor.
seed_details.destination_search: Ordinary minimax regression and inhomogeneous-design papers do not isolate a replicated-site pointwise spacing phase across arbitrary \(T:n_s\) ratios.
seed_details.red_team: Replication only replaces variance by \(1/n_s\) in Stone's bias--variance calculation.
seed_details.rebuttal: That substitution misses the regime in which the optimal bandwidth is below the realized site spacing and response replication cannot improve interpolation bias.

seed_details.anchor_read: Introduction; Theorems 2.1--2.2; fixed-length folded-normal calibration; Appendix proof; empirical terminal section.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Derive rather than assume the centered calendar-block limit after generated-center and moving-Gram perturbations, then add all first-order bias radii.
seed_details.destination_search: Bias-aware nonparametric intervals and dependent panel prediction intervals exist separately, but no result combines the four active scales with conditional causal-mean honesty.
seed_details.red_team: Condition on the donor center and apply Armstrong--Kolesar with a block variance estimator.
seed_details.rebuttal: Conditioning does not control the target shift, moving neighborhoods, realized holes, or uniform covariance replacement when donor error is itself the active phase.

seed_details.anchor_read: Introduction; equivalent-kernel moment construction; Theorem 4.4 on multivariate local-linear minimax efficiency; ending discussion.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Impose a low-rank or shared-index structure on stacked event paths so smoothing uses dimension \(p\) rather than \(p(H+1)\).
seed_details.destination_search: Tensor local-polynomial theory supplies dimension \(d\), but the topic contains no low-rank path restriction that would identify a \(p\)-dimensional index.
seed_details.red_team: The dimension reduction is assumed rather than learned from the panel.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds; the core honestly fixes \(d=p(H+1)\) and leaves structured dimension reduction outside scope.

seed_details.anchor_read: Introduction; Theorem 1 and its convex-path coverage-to-testing proof; Theorem 2 and its localized bump construction; final remarks.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Embed four legal causal subexperiments and apply coverage-to-testing inequalities separately before maximizing their expected-length lower bounds.
seed_details.destination_search: Honest nonparametric expected-length lower bounds do not combine treated replication, random holes, and a full-covariance generated location in one class.
seed_details.red_team: The lower bound is automatic once the four estimation alternatives are written down.
seed_details.rebuttal: Coverage lower bounds are channelwise, but legality inside one causal class and uniformity at every relative-growth boundary require distinct constructions and prohibit several tempting degenerate witnesses.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: lem:causal-identification and Theorems 1–3
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Event-date transport, E[B_si(0)|z_0]=m_s(z_0s), is an untestable cross-date counterfactual premise rather than a consequence of the observed panel.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: All causal identification, frontier, and interval claims are conditional on event-date transport; rolling pseudo-events can only diagnose pre-event stability.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorems 1–3; ass:attainable-local-modulus
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The lower covariance-standardized modulus supplying the N^(-kappa) converse is maintained rather than derived from Holder smoothness or the remaining panel primitives.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The four-channel MSE and expected-length equivalences are conditional on ass:attainable-local-modulus; because this focal rate channel is assumed, the proposal is capped at field tier.

banked_reason: The matched three-channel MSE and expected-length rates are proved over a bespoke union of labelled fixed-query conditional-kernel classes, not over the joint causal panel-law class.
banked_proposal_promise_gap: The original sharp causal panel frontier is under-delivered: actual panel laws receive identification and upper risk/coverage/length transfer, but no panel-induced converse, genuine FWL anchor, or named DID reductions.
